title: Swim safely
intro: SwimQuest is a game. Your safety always comes first.
heroAlt: Swimmers at sunrise on a calm coast

night.title: No night swimming
night.body: Only swim in daylight, when others can see you and you can see the water.

alone.title: Never swim alone in open water
alone.body: Swim with a buddy or where a lifeguard is watching, and tell someone where you are.

limits.title: Swim within your limits
limits.body: Stop and rest when you are tired or cold. No distance is worth a risk.

map.title: The map is only an illustration
map.body: The voyage map is a game picture, not a real route. Do not use it to navigate the water.

reminder.text: Swim in daylight, never alone in open water, and within your limits.
